name: Create a deploy key
description: Create a deploy key You can create a read-only deploy key. POST /repos/{owner}/{repo}/keys
context:
POST /repos/{owner}/{repo}/keys
You can create a read-only deploy key.
Required: owner (path) — The account owner of the repository. The name is not case sensitive.; repo (path) — The name of the repository without the `.git` extension. The name is not case sensitive.; body (body)

description: Delete a deploy key Deploy keys are immutable. DELETE /repos/{owner}/{repo}/keys/{key_id}
